text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: SEVERITY: P1 - service=inference-gateway-us-west1 - 5xx error rate spike above threshold (current: 18%, threshold: 5%)

pagerduty: Pager fired: inference-gateway-us-west1 (see PD: https://pagerduty.example.com/incidents/PD12345)

sara (oncall): ack'd. I'm taking initial ownership. confirming region and customer impact? :eyes:

michael (eng-sre): seeing a big jump in 5xxs from uw1-ingress -> 502/504 from proxy layer. graphs: http://grafana/reports/5xx-spike-usw1 (link)

sara (oncall): thanks. can we identify whether it's upstream model pods or the frontend LB?

jack (infra): tailing logs now. early grep shows repeated: `upstream reset before response` and `connection reset by peer` from kv-proxy sidecar.

emily (support): Support ticket volume rising: 4 tickets flagged as "generation failed (500)" in the last 8m, including one paying customer on swarm plan. escalating to CS lead.

michael (eng-sre): digging into pod metrics - CPU fine, but worker threads have queue latency spike. cache misses spiked at the same time. suspect kvcache eviction + increased tail latency -> upstream timeouts.

sara (oncall): runbook step 1: check kvcache eviction rate and recent changes. anyone pushed config?

jack (infra): no infra deploys in last 30m. I see a config rollout for redis-cluster at 16:02 UTC earlier, but PD shows it completed before spike. logs:```
redis-client WARN key eviction: aggressive_eviction=true
kvcache: evicted 812 keys in 60s
```

michael (eng-sre): yep, that aligns. eviction causing cold starts on KV lookups -> more upstream calls -> overload. quick mitigation: reduce traffic hitting affected proxy pool and warm caches. options: 1) route a slice of traffic to eu-west1; 2) reduce route weight for us-west1; 3) bump kvcache size if we can hotpatch.

sara (oncall): decision: 1) shift 20% traffic off usam-west1 to eu-west1, 2) kick a kvcache warm job for top prefixes, 3) notify customers. jack, can you run the weight shift?

jack (infra): doing weight shift now.```
# curl to router-api
POST /v1/route/shift {"from":"us-west1","to":"eu-west1","pct":20}
# response 200 OK
```
jack (infra): traffic shift applied. watching.

michael (eng-sre): starting a cache warm job (small fanout) to reload top-100 prefixes to kvcache. job submitted: job-kwarm-175314.

emily (support): posting note to status page draft: "We're investigating increased 5xxs in US-West. Some customers may see failed requests. We are applying mitigations now." Shall I publish?

sara (oncall): publish now and include workaround (retry/backoff) + ETA 15-30m. emily please add we are shifting traffic and warming caches.

emily (support): published: https://status.redwood.example/incident/INC-175314 (draft -> live)

michael (eng-sre): metrics update: 5xx rate dropping to 9% after shift, error 502 proportion falling. KV miss rate decreasing as warm job progresses.

sara (oncall): good. keep shift for 30m, if stable we can roll traffic back gradually. any need for rollback or capacity increase?

jack (infra): no node scale needed yet. I see some proxy restarts correlated with the spike. root cause looks like Redis eviction policy change caused kvcache churn. I'll open infra ticket to revert or tune.

michael (eng-sre): follow-up: adding a temporary circuit-breaker config on the proxy to reduce retry amplification. patch applied to canary (10% hosts).```
# proxy config snippet
circuit_breakers: {max_retries: 2, per_host_limit: 50}
```

sara (oncall): excellent. final checks: customer impact summary? emily?

emily (support): 4 active tickets; 1 high-touch customer affected intermittently. CS alerted, offering temporary mitigation guidance (increase app-level retries). No data loss reported.

sara (oncall): timeline: 16:04 - pager fired; 16:06 - ack; 16:10 - weight shift applied; 16:12 - cache warm job started; 16:25 - 5xx rate down to ~6-9%. current status: partial mitigation in place, monitoring.

michael (eng-sre): I'll keep a watch for 30m and then propose full remediation (tune redis eviction and/or increase kvcache memory).

jack (infra): filing infra-ticket INFRA-8921 to revert redis eviction flag and schedule safe change window.

sara (oncall): handoff to night oncall in 45m. if stable by then, we'll annotate runbook and close PD. tagging for postmortem if cause confirmed.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD12345 updated: status=investigating -> acknowledged -> mitigated (partial).

emily (support): updating customers with current note and ETA.

sara (oncall): thanks all. I'll keep this thread pinned. if anything spikes again, re-alert and escalate to platform leads. :thumbsup:
